name: PT-76
protection: Very thin steel (amphibious). Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Long flat boat-like hull with six road wheels per side and no return rollers
Small conical turret with 76 mm gun
Water jets at the rear for swimming; trim vane folded on the glacis
